laws.rule: Mathaf, Education City: tickets are required and valid for a single entry on the admission date. Tickets are available on arrival; advance time-slot reservation is optional. Groups of 25 or more are asked to arrange a ticket block in advance. This is not a municipality-wide entry permit or mandatory online-booking law.

Mathaf allows personal non-commercial photography with available light unless otherwise indicated. Flash, tripods and selfie sticks are not permitted. Formal photography/filming requests use the museum's request form at least two weeks in advance; ordinary permitted personal photographs are not automatically recast as needing that form. Specific exhibition restrictions still apply.

Mathaf requires modest dress covering shoulders and knees and may refuse unsuitable clothing. Do not touch artworks or take food/drinks into galleries. Regular-pencil sketching is allowed, but coloured pencils, ink pens and markers are excluded from galleries. Children under 12 must have an adult; bag/security checks apply and large bags must be stored. These are this museum's conditions, not all Al Rayyan public-space rules.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Cover shoulders and knees; unsuitable clothing may lead to refused entry. Respect artworks and others, no gallery food/drinks, phones on vibrate and calls outside galleries. Follow posted exhibit restrictions.
culture-and-protocol.photography_and_story_permissions: Personal non-commercial available-light photos allowed unless a specific restriction says otherwise; no flash, tripods or selfie sticks. Formal photography/filming requests at least two weeks ahead through museum process. This does not grant permission to record visitors or tell a community's stories.
